description: A fictional cutting beam tool game prop for a builder, chunky low-poly, held level with the lens hood forward. One slim flat-topped muted olive painted body with wide chamfers and one thick flat charcoal strip along the full length of its top; at its rear end one thick chamfered octagonal dark steel end cap. The front half is one dark steel emitter barrel threaded through exactly four thick square dark steel cooling fins with even gaps, ending at the tip in one thick chamfered square dark steel lens hood with a recessed round dark lens. One small rectangular teal lamp window in a thick raised charcoal bezel on the left flank of the body. Under the front of the body one fat squared charcoal vertical front handle with a thick base block; under the middle one squared charcoal trigger guard with a thick trigger and one chunky charcoal pistol grip raked back with big diagonal ribs; under the rear one thick boxy charcoal cell pack.
proportions: About 0.80 m long, 0.10 m wide and 0.28 m tall. (length : width : height = 8.00 : 1 : 2.80)
